reviews.text: I participated in a puppy party. It was great for getting used to people through cuddling!

I've been watching Yuto-sensei's videos for a while now, so I decided to participate in the puppy party. My puppy had so much fun playing with the other dogs, and it was a really enjoyable time for me as well.

We were able to spend a very meaningful time socializing our puppy, which is a crucial period in puppyhood!

It was wonderful to see our puppy's happy expression and to see him getting along with the other dogs that were there!
I think I gained a lot of useful knowledge.

I started taking my puppy there for socialization ^^

Knowing that it had just opened, I visited the Ota Omori branch with a friend. While I usually use a different branch, the new location had a wonderful atmosphere, and the staff were all very kind and helpful, making me feel at ease.

During the free consultation, they carefully listened to my dog's personality, daily life, and any problems I was experiencing, providing personalized advice.

I really appreciated their emphasis on positive reinforcement training, focusing on understanding the dog's feelings rather than forcing instruction.

Even in such a short time, they praised my dog, saying things like, "Look how much he's grown!" As a dog owner, I was very happy.

At the doggy daycare, they carefully considered the dogs' size and compatibility, creating a safe and comfortable environment.

The store itself was very clean and tidy, and the staff were friendly and easy to talk to, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere.

I would definitely like to use their services again if I have the opportunity! I would recommend this store to anyone looking to improve their dog's obedience and socialization skills.

It was enjoyable to hear about various things.
Thank you very much.
However, the price quoted on the website and the price presented on the day of the visit differed by more than 10,000 yen.
I'm glad you taught me so many things.
